## Invitations

A total of 517 people were invited to attend. Of these, 351 attended, giving an attendance rate of 67.9 per cent. The result indicates that most invited people attended, while a smaller number did not take up the invitation.

The invitation process included direct contact by SMS. This provided an additional way to communicate the appointment information and support attendance.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 440 invitations. A reminder message was also sent to 440 people. These communications were intended to reinforce the appointment details and encourage attendance.

Staff continue to phone people who missed two appointments. This follow-up supports contact with people who have not attended and provides an opportunity to discuss future arrangements.

Prepared by G. Evans.
